title: •Establish Secret Base
caption: •Establish Secret Base (V)
game_text: If you control Bunker, deploy on Endor system. At each Endor site you control with an AT-ST or biker scout, opponent’s Force generation is canceled. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Aratech Corporation or an Effect with “Endor” in the lore or game text. {alter}
lore: The Empire’s remote bases develop new technology and hide sensitive projects from potential Rebel saboteurs.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; curly double quotes around “Endor”; curly apostrophe in opponent’s; red circle-slash A → {alter}. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Empire’s (wiki straight). Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: V7-D-establishsecretbase.gif (745 px, the PC's Virtual Set 7 remake — a later, different (V) card; art may be better); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
